title: A Trip to Machu Picchu
text:
Last summer, Maria visited Peru with her friends. They took a train to Machu Picchu, an old city high in the mountains. The journey was long, but the view was beautiful.

On the second day, they walked along a small path and met a local guide named Carlos. He showed them how farmers grow potatoes on the hills. Maria took many photos and wrote notes for her travel blog.

questions.text: How did Maria and her friends travel to Machu Picchu?
What was the name of the local guide?
What can we infer about Maria from the passage?
options: She is interested in travel and writing
She has never left her country

questions.text: Why did Maria take many photos?
options: She wanted to remember the trip and share it
She needed them for a school exam

vocabulary.definition: a trip from one place to another
a person who shows other people around a place

paragraph_translations: El verano pasado, Maria visitó Perú con sus amigos. Tomaron un tren a Machu Picchu, una antigua ciudad en lo alto de las montañas. El viaje fue largo, pero la vista era hermosa.

El segundo día, caminaron por un pequeño sendero y conocieron a un guía local llamado Carlos. Él les mostró cómo los agricultores cultivan papas en las colinas. Maria tomó muchas fotos y escribió notas para su blog de viajes.
